dedupe_keys.name: hisland sa annual 1 km crop specific gridded data for south america 1950 2020

description: HISLAND-SA gives annual 1 km maps of soybean, maize, wheat and rice fractions across South America from 1950 to 2020. The Zenodo record says they combine historical agricultural census data, model-based crop type data and high resolution remote sensing crop type data, with higher spatial and temporal resolution than earlier reconstructions, and it includes a state mask, code and a readme. It was published in November 2024 by researchers at Huazhong Agricultural University, Boston College and other institutions under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as zips of about 1.35 GB. Coverage is South America. Caveats: early decades rest on census reconstruction, and the file format is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives long crop area histories to model agricultural expansion, exposure trends and supply from major soybean and maize exporters. Related catalogue records include the Argentina national map of crops and the mechanized crop types of Mato Grosso and MATOPIBA.
name: HISLAND-SA - annual 1 km crop-specific gridded data for South America (1950-2020)
